heading: Today
text: Showers likely through NY and from I-89 south, diminishing in the afternoon.  A few breaks of sun in Quebec, and northeast, with a chance of showers late.  Highs in the mid 60s to mid 70s, coolest south.  Winds light, mainly southeast less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: A few evening showers, more likely southwest, tapering off.  Mostly cloudy, some breaks far north.  Lows in the 50s.  Winds becoming south to southeast 5 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west, remaining light east.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy, possible a few morning sprinkles.  A rising chance of showers mid to late afternoon, mostly likely in NY, perhaps east to the Green Mountains.  Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s.  Winds southeast, becoming south 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.
